speaker: UNKNOWN
title: "Quinton de kock made it easy" | Janneman Malan post match press conference | SA v IND - 2nd ODI
quote_text:
Well done on your knock I just wanted to ask you how did you find the Indian bowling attacks the first beginnings that you played against them because guys like Bumrah, Ashwin, Chahal how was the experience overall?

A guy like me I’ve always seen them bowl in the IPL and all the international games they play so it's it was good to get out and kind of get game time against them it's yeah you need more time to face guys like that because you need to get the rhythm up of each and every one of them so it's a kind of a challenge for me to do it in the first and second game but yeah it's obviously not the best the base bowling conditions in terms of Guillain-Barre it's a sluggish wicket but yeah they take a world-class team and bowlers and it's good to be able to get a challenge from there.

Congratulations on the serious win, I want to know from you in your opinion what seems to have worked for South Africa in winning the ODI series either in chasing or in setting up a total?

I think what worked for us if we look at moments in the game I think we played we handled their total overs of spin I think we handled it better than them facing our spinner so that's a good confidence for us our spenders they were nice and tight then also building partnerships and working hard for every run I think we did well as a boating unit to keep getting a wicked and they had a chance to get a big score today but we just kept getting wicked so they couldn't go at too much at the end where we kept breaking their momentum but I think the partnerships we built as bad as kind of gave us the edge
